h1: Image tagging and alt text for your product photos
overview: Search engines and screen readers cannot see your photos, so they depend on the words around them. We review your product images, write short alt text that describes what is shown and add useful tags such as color, style and setting. The text is plain and helpful, not stuffed with keywords. Results are loaded into your store or returned as a sheet you can check first.

faq: It lets people who use screen readers understand your products, and it gives search engines context for images. Accessible stores also tend to serve more customers.
They describe what is visible, such as a navy cotton shirt on a hanger. A person spot checks a sample, and unclear images are listed for you to confirm.
Can you tag images for my Google Shopping feed?
We can supply color, material and pattern values that match your feed attributes. We cannot promise approval, as Google decides that on its own rules.
Do you need my product photos sent to you?
No. We work from your store or a shared folder with limited access. We do not keep copies of your images after the job is delivered.
